ENGAGEMENT OF SPECIALIST CADRE OFFICERS ON CONTRACT BASIS
ADVERTISEMENT NO. CRPD/CR/2026-27/04 – CORRIGENDUM
EXISTING GUIDELINES REVISED GUIDELINES
Refer Page No.3 Point A (Selection
Procedure) of the detailed advertisement,
which is as under:
Selection Procedure: Shortlisting and
interview
Refer Page No.3 Point A (Selection
Procedure) of the detailed advertisement,
which is as under:
Selection Procedure: Shortlisting-cum
Written assessment and interview.
Written Assessment: At the time of Interview,
the shortlisted candidates will be provided with
actual URF (User Requirement Form) and they
shall prepare Business Requirement Document
for the said requirement.
All the Shortlisted candidates will appear in
both the Written Assessment and Interview.
Candidates have to qualify in both the Written
Assessment and Interview.
The qualifying marks of written assessment
and interview will be decided by the Bank. No
correspondence will be entertained in this
regard.
All other terms and conditions mentioned in the captioned advertisement shall remail unchanged.
Place: Mumbai General Manager
